successors.name: Royal domain of France
successors.text: the county, which 'reverted to the crown' with the death of Renard II in 1055; 'définitivement rattaché au domaine royal par Henri Ier en 1055'

ledger.x: 987: the county of Sens enters the map under its hereditary counts.
1003: a block at Sens and Joigny goes to the Champagne shape.
1015: Renard II keeps the county as the king's vassal.
1055: Renard II dies and the county is annexed.

wars.name: Robert II's seizure of Sens
wars.outcome: The king seized Sens on 22 April 1015; Renard II kept the county as a vassal and it reverted to the crown at his death in 1055.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the shape is the department of Yonne without Auxerre, and the French page's wider pagus of the Senones is not drawn.
